title: Cultural Re-contextualization of Fairness Research in Language Technologies in India
benchmark_measurement: Sentiment bias associated with religious identity terms, measured by shifts in sentiment scores in response to perturbation analysis.
findings: The study found that the sentiment model tested (a DistillBERT fine-tuned with SST-2) learned to associate higher negative sentiment with marginalized religious groups, specifically with the term 'Muslim'. The paper also mentions building a dataset of stereotypes around the Religion axis.
